author_reason.description:
Why, as told to the owner.
 @since 261008

content_actions.description:
What it did to the content.
 @since 261008

note.description: Internal, seen only by the committee and contributors.

AttachmentInput.description:
An attachment as sent by the client.
 @since 261106

AttachmentView.description:
An attachment as shown: `{ "type", "data" }`, where `data` is in the shape its type defines, or
 null when what it points at can't be seen any more, shown as "unavailable". Clients show types
 they don't know as "update to see this".

 Typed per type, not as a JSON value, so the OpenAPI document describes each type's `data` and
 the compatibility check covers it.
 @since 261106

anyOf.description: A stored type this server doesn't know, such as one a newer version wrote before a rollback.

reasons.description: Pending reports per reason, most first.

content_actions.description:
Content actions a contributor can take now, each with the verdict it goes with.
 @since 261008

verdicts.description: Verdicts a contributor can choose now; empty when there is nothing to decide on.

CommentItem.description:
A comment as shown to one viewer.
 @since 261021

removed.description: Deleted or hidden, kept only so its replies have a place. Shown as "this comment was removed".

reply_to_user.description: Whom a reply to another reply answers; `None` for a top-level comment and a reply to it.

CommentPreview.description:
How a comment looks: its text, and what it's on as that target's kind shows it.
 @since 261021

on.description: What the comment is on; None if it's gone.

CommentThread.description:
A top-level comment and the first few replies under it.
 @since 261021

code.description:
Error code type, should be machine-friendly and human-readable.
 e.g: `"permission_denied"`, `"not_found"`

msg.description:
Explain the reason, could be displayed to user.
 e.g: `"You don't have permission to access this resource"`

action.description:
Declared by the target's kind: `hide` and `restore` for songs and playlists, `reset_avatar`,
 `reset_bio` and `reset_username` for users.

penalty.description: Acts against the content, so the owner must be told why (`author_reason`).

verdict.description: The verdict it can be taken with.

ContentIntent.description:
Where the client goes when the user taps "去查看". Only for navigation; the target page checks
 existence and permission itself.

 `action` is a dot-separated lowercase name such as `song.comment.view`, and `data` holds the
 ids the page needs, such as `{ "song_id": 1, "comment_id": 2 }`. Never put URLs or display text
 in `data`. The client maps each action to a route; add the client mapping together with the
 producer that first uses an action.

 @since 261005

reply_to_id.description:
The comment to reply to, a top-level comment or a reply under one; omit to comment on the
 target.

attachments.description:
`{ type, data }` each. For now up to 1, a `song` (`{ "id": <song id> }`) or a `playlist`
 (`{ "id": <playlist id> }`, public).

content.description: Up to 500 characters, trimmed. May be empty when there are images or attachments.

comment.description:
The new comment; `None` if it couldn't be checked now and waits to be checked again. It's
 seen by no one, its author included, until it passes.

moment.description:
The new moment; `None` if it couldn't be checked now and waits to be checked again. It's
 seen by no one, its author included, until it passes; if it's blocked then, its author gets
 a notification.

history_id.description: Same value as `PlayHistoryItem.id`, which is the song id

songs.description: Songs that can be played, by `order_index`.

unavailable_songs.description:
Songs in the playlist that were deleted or hidden, to show as unavailable in their place.
 @since 261008

next_request_time.description: When a change without the old email can be requested again, if not now.

FeedItem.description:
One entry of a stream: `{ "time", "kind", "data" }`, where `kind` says what `data` is.
 @since 261106

time.description: When it happened, which orders the stream.

hidden.description: Whether the user's song or playlist is hidden.

target_id.description: The song id, not its display id.

threads.description: Most liked first. Also in `/comment/list`, in their place by time.

KnownAttachment.description:
An attachment of a type this server knows, with its `data`.
 @since 261109

oneOf.description: The song's public detail, as in song lists.
The playlist's metadata, as in playlist lists.

sha256.description:
Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the package. `None` for versions published without it.
 @since 261001

size.description:
Package size in bytes. `None` for versions published without it.
 @since 261001

cursor.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page; omit for the first page.

before_id.description: The last `notification_id` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

after_comment_id.description: `comment.id` of the previous page's last thread.

after_time.description: `comment.create_time` of the previous page's last thread. Omit both for the first page.

target_id.description: The song id, not its display id.

total.description: Visible comments and replies on the target, for showing next to it.

next_cursor.description: Pass it back as `cursor` for the next page; `None` when there's no more.

unread_count.description: May be non-zero if a notification arrived meanwhile.

channel.description:
`like`, `follow` or `reply` (since 261021). System notifications are marked through
 `/notification/*`.

read_time.description: The first time it was marked read.

unread_count.description: Use this to replace the badge instead of counting locally.

can_resolve.description: Can decide on reports and appoint members: contributors.

can_view.description: Can read the report queue: committee members and contributors.

thumb_url.description: At most 480 pixels on the long side, for lists.

MomentItem.description:
A moment as shown to one viewer.
 @since 261106

is_hidden.description: Hidden by a report decision; only its author sees it then.

MomentPreview.description:
How a moment looks: its text and the thumbnails of its images.
 @since 261106

data.description: Likes of songs that can be played.

unavailable.description:
Likes on this page of songs that were deleted or hidden, to show as unavailable.
 @since 261008

type.description: `<domain>.<event>`. Clients must still show notifications of unknown types.

content_intent.description: Where "去查看" goes. Clients hide the button for actions they don't know.

notification_id.description: UUIDv7. Newer notifications have greater ids.

OtherAttachment.description:
An attachment of a type this server doesn't know, shown with no `data`.
 @since 261109

unavailable.description: Favorites on this page whose playlists have been deleted or hidden.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page; omit for the first page.

items.description: Newest first. Skip kinds you don't know.

is_hidden.description:
Hidden by the platform; only its owner sees it.
 @since 261008

PublicUserProfile.description:
Shared user profile model — returned by all APIs that include user info.
 `is_following` / `is_followed_by` are `None` unless enriched via `get_user_profile`.

is_followed_by.description: @since 260619 — None when viewing own profile or unauthenticated, or when caller uses `get_common_user_profile`

is_following.description: @since 260619 — None when viewing own profile or unauthenticated, or when caller uses `get_common_user_profile`

explicit.description: @since 251105, should be required in new client.

jmid.description: @since 251114, should be required in new client.

sha256.description:
Hex SHA-256 of the package (64 characters, stored lowercase).
 @since 261001

size.description:
Package size in bytes, must be positive.
 @since 261001

before_id.description: `case_id` of the previous page's last item.

before_time.description: `last_report_time` of the previous page's last item. Omit both for the first page.

ReceivedLikeItem.description:
The likes one song received from others.
 @since 261006

like_count.description: All likes from others, not only unread ones.

before_song_id.description: `song_id` of the previous page's last item.

before_time.description: `latest_like_time` of the previous page's last item. Omit both for the first page.

before_comment_id.description: `comment.id` of the previous page's last item.

before_time.description: `comment.create_time` of the previous page's last item. Omit both for the first page.

ReceivedReplyItem.description:
A comment replying to the user, or on what they own.
 @since 261021

replied_content.description:
The user's comment it replies to; `None` for a comment on what they own, or if that comment
 was deleted.

ReplyTarget.description:
What a received reply is on.
 @since 261021

author_reason.description:
Shown to the owner, up to 500 characters; required for penalties.
 @since 261008

content_actions.description:
From the case's `content_actions` for this verdict.
 @since 261008

ignore_reports.description: Record further reports without reopening the case.

up_to_report_id.description: The last pending report the operator saw; later ones stay pending. 0 if there was none.

token.description: From the link in the email to the old address

audio_url.description:
Deprecated since 260114.
 Use detail endpoint to get audio URL

status.description: `running`, `success` or `failure`. `running` for a past run means the server stopped during it.

SongPreview.description:
How a song looks, here and wherever something on a song shows it.
 @since 261021

already_reviewed.description:
The target was reviewed before and further reports on it are ignored. The report is
 recorded anyway.

follow_read_time.description: Followers who followed after this are new.

reply_unread.description:
At most 100, which the client shows as "99+".
 @since 261021

total_unread.description: Sum of the unread counts below, for the entry badge.

preview.description:
How the target looks, by its kind, with `type` naming the kind.
 @since 261021

UgcPreview.description:
How a target looks, in the shape of its kind, with `type` naming the kind. Each variant carries
 the preview its kind's file defines; [enum_dispatch] implements [Preview] for the enum by
 forwarding to it, as [UgcKind] does for adapters.
 @since 261021

oneOf.description:
Not reportable, but comments can be on posts.
 @since 261024

image_id.description: Pass it to `/moment/create` within an hour.
